stories.subject: US-P2: Establish CI/CD Coverage Thresholds & Enforcement
stories.description:
Medium-term: Implement automated coverage validation across all languages:
- Set language-specific coverage thresholds
- Pre-commit hooks for new code test validation
- CI/CD coverage gates that block merges
- Coverage reporting dashboard
- Trend tracking and regression prevention

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Coverage thresholds defined for each language:
  - Python: 85% (overall), 90% (security)
  - TypeScript: 80% (overall), 90% (critical paths)
  - Rust: 90% (overall)
  - Go: 80% (overall)
  - Java: 70% (overall)
- Pre-commit hooks validate new files have tests
- CI/CD blocks merges below thresholds
- Coverage reports generated per PR
- Historical coverage trend tracking

**Priority:** P2 - Medium-term
**Effort:** 3-4 days
**Languages:** All (Python, TypeScript, Rust, Go, Java)
**Tags:** CI/CD, Automation, Quality Gates

  - TypeScript: Jest/Vitest component/hook templates

  - Java: JUnit test templates
- Comprehensive testing documentation
- Code examples and best practices
- Developer guide for writing tests
- Templates integrated into project scaffolding

**Priority:** P2 - Medium-term
**Effort:** 2-3 days
**Languages:** All (Python, TypeScript, Rust, Go, Java)
**Tags:** Documentation, Templates, Developer Experience
